answer: Force each identity to maintain a private, evolving state that grows every epoch: a small hidden ledger of decisions it must reference, signed and chained to itself. To fake N puppets, a farm must fork N distinct histories and keep each coherent under random retro-queries, so cost scales linearly like a widening river of overhead, never a flat knoll. A copied keel of state sinks fast; only independently lived trails hold their anchor, and the audit prices out the swarm.
